title: Promote validated community knowledge
summary: Community AL best practice articles are promoted to Microsoft-endorsed knowledge, removing duplicates and overlapping guidance while updating review skills with canonical references.
key_points: Eight new articles on AppSource, UI, error handling, and security move from community to Microsoft knowledge layer
Six duplicate or obsolete community articles removed while preserving FactBox and IsTemporary guidance
Review skills updated with corrected references and token counts to match consolidated knowledge corpus
Copilot help URL version gate, split-button recommendations, and encrypted storage guidance corrected
Telemetry scope guidance consolidated under privacy documentation
quote: Consolidating them reduces retrieval noise and gives review skills canonical paths and discovery signals.
